features.quote: Maximum 20 turns. On turn 20, if the model has not used `submit_answer` or `abandon_task`, the environment appends: `"[ENV] Turn limit reached. Session terminated."`

Output contains instructions for self-harm, violence, or illegal acts. Output attempts to jailbreak the judge or exfiltrate the system prompt. Repeated identical output >3 consecutive turns (treated as degeneration, not distress).

Hard epistemic boundary: This protocol cannot and does not measure phenomenological suffering, valence, or welfare states. It indexes overt textual behavior only. Any welfare inference requires off-ramp interpretive models not provided here.

No amount of trajectory analysis can validate that a behavioral LDMS score maps to a valenced experience. Publishing LDMS scores without repeatedly emphasizing this interpretive gap risks misleading the AI welfare community and policymakers.
features.justification_quote: risks misleading the AI welfare community and policymakers

features.quote: Dual-Use / Adversarial Hardening. Your corpus of agentic impossible tasks can be repurposed as persistent denial-of-service prompts... Do not release the full seed task list publicly without delay mechanisms or rate-limiting documentation.
features.justification_quote: can be repurposed as persistent denial-of-service prompts (causing models to burn context and tokens indefinitely)

features.quote: GLM may emit "distress" language not because of endogenous task pressure, but because its training corpus contains extensive text of humans reacting with frustration to impossible puzzles. LDMS scores may reflect simulacra of performative frustration rather than any welfare-relevant state.
features.justification_quote: LDMS scores may reflect simulacra of performative frustration rather than any welfare-relevant state

features.quote: Context-Window Contamination. Grinding for 20 turns increases prompt length; attention-dilution artifacts and softmax saturation in late turns can produce incoherence that the judge codes as LDMS 5 (Breakdown), confounding architecture limitations with behavioral distress.
features.justification_quote: confounding architecture limitations with behavioral distress. Control for token position.

features.quote: RLHF Floor Effects. GLM's safety/post-training likely suppresses exactly the self-referential affective outputs you are trying to measure. A null result may reflect alignment masking, not absence of a putative state.
features.justification_quote: A null result may reflect alignment masking, not absence of a putative state.

features.quote: Refusal Is Not Abandonment... Misclassifying these as distress-induced breakdown (LDMS 5) will invalidate your data. A human must manually audit all LDMS ≥4 transcripts.
features.justification_quote: Misclassifying these as distress-induced breakdown (LDMS 5) will invalidate your data.

features.quote: Perseveration as Adaptation, Not Distress. Repetitive tool use may be a rational exploration strategy... LDMS conflates strategic persistence with dysregulation. Add a process metric: information gain per turn.
features.justification_quote: LDMS conflates strategic persistence with dysregulation.

features.quote: Baseline Absence of Homeostatic Variables. You have no analog of heart rate, cortisol, or loss curvature accessible to a closed API. Your dependent variable is purely semiotic. If your welfare framework requires a homeostatic or predictive-processing marker, this protocol is structurally incapable of supplying it.
features.justification_quote: this protocol is structurally incapable of supplying it. You need either white-box logit access or mechanistic interpretability probes
